classification: post-hoc promotion validation of the R331 Top10 diagnostic; no parameter or weight search
discipline: No TopN, weight, lookback, target-vol, asset or threshold changes are allowed.
Top10 is disclosed as post-hoc relative to R331 and cannot be presented as an independent discovery.
No paper target, order file or production write is generated.
disclosure: R331 was preregistered to select the Top20 three-asset bucket and label Top10 as diagnostic-only. R331 Top20 failed only 2022 (-0.36%) and robustness calendar gates. The R331 Top10 diagnostic passed all full-path performance and concentration gates. R332 explicitly treats Top10 as a post-hoc candidate and tests it under the same fixed rules plus additional promotion gates.

fixed_strategy.A_B_combination: 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity, A bounds [0.2,0.8], then 15% annualized volatility target [0.2,1.0] gross
fixed_strategy.equity_vs_bucket: 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity; 15% annualized vol target; gross [0.2,1.0]; no leverage

full_path_gates: Reuse R331 D1-D4 + G1-G10 + C1-C12 unchanged.
known_limitations: The sample contains strong gold and dividend regimes.
Industry classification is a current snapshot backfilled through history.
Five overlapping fresh-start paths are robustness checks, not five independent samples.

promotion_gates.P1_stress: 3x equity cost + 0.30% overlay cost total return >0 and MDD >= -25%
promotion_gates.P2_fresh_starts: at least 4 of 5 fresh-start phases have positive total return; every phase MDD >= -18%
promotion_gates.P3_full_curve: curve starts 2021-06-01 and ends 2026-11-05 with D4 guard
promotion_gates.selection: all full-path, robustness, stress and fresh-start gates must pass; otherwise no candidate
